description.default: Rank concrete HR tasks for the signed-in employee by urgency and impact. Use for prompts such as 'What should I do next?', 'Show my HR priorities', or 'What HR tasks are most urgent?'. Do not use for a broad status summary; use GetMyHRDashboard, or for profile-only recommendations; use GetProfileHealth. Pass period or focusArea when explicit, and set includeSensitive only when requested.
